nodes.text: Portable Golden Corpus Fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic source documents authored for NOMOS regression tests.
They are license-safe and intentionally avoid legal, regulatory, certification, or
validation claims. The `Portable` Go test emits the feed, TOC, no-lexicon status,
body ledger, fidelity report, and strict gate output for every domain.
AI Governance Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes oversight for an AI-assisted extraction feature
without claiming model certification, risk-framework compliance, or regulatory
approval.
Evaluation Record

The record stores prompt version, model identifier, source citation policy,
refusal behavior, and reviewer decision as auditable fields.
Drift Review

The workflow schedules periodic comparison between approved outputs and new
model outputs before changing production behavior.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim AI governance compliance, safety assurance, or legal
adequacy. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with license-safe
text.
Cyber Supplier Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes supplier security review without quoting any
standard, audit report, or restricted security questionnaire.
Supplier Intake

The record captures service boundary, data category, security contact, and
review status before technical evidence is evaluated.
Control Evidence

The workflow links submitted evidence, reviewer note, residual risk, and renewal
date without asserting that a control is externally certified.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim cyber compliance, supplier assurance certification,
or security adequacy. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with
license-safe text.
Finance RegTech Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes a control narrative for financial reporting
change review without quoting regulation or claiming regulatory compliance.
Control Objective

The record links data source, transformation rule, reconciliation evidence, and
approval status for a reporting workflow.
Exception Handling

The workflow records exception reason, impacted report, owner decision, and
follow-up evidence before any status is closed.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim financial regulatory compliance, audit acceptance,
or legal sufficiency. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with
license-safe text.
GxP CSV Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes a controlled software change without quoting any
external standard, regulation, or licensed guidance. The scenario is limited to
traceability evidence for a validation planning workflow.
Intake Boundary

The intake record identifies intended use, affected workflow, source owner, and
review status before any downstream evidence artifact is generated.
Evidence Flow

The workflow keeps requirements, test steps, deviations, and approval notes as
separate evidence objects so that a reviewer can inspect each link.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim GxP compliance, validation approval, Part 11
compliance, or certification. It only exercises portable corpus artifact
generation with license-safe text.
High Assurance Engineering Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes high-assurance engineering evidence without
claiming formal methods proof, safety certification, or regulatory approval.
Design Constraint

The record captures invariant statement, design rationale, implementation owner,
and review status as separate traceable statements.
Verification Evidence

The workflow links static analysis, test evidence, change review, and exception
handling so each result can be inspected independently.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim safety certification, complete proof, or regulated
validation. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with
license-safe text.
Legal eDiscovery Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes a document-hold workflow without giving legal
advice or claiming discovery adequacy.
Hold Intake

The record captures matter reference, custodian group, preservation scope, and
review status as source-backed statements.
Production Review

The workflow separates collection, deduplication, privilege review, and export
decision so each step can be traced to a responsible reviewer.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim legal sufficiency, privilege correctness, or court
acceptance. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with
license-safe text.
Medical SaMD Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes a software risk-control narrative for a medical
software context without asserting device clearance, clinical performance, or
regulatory conformity.
Intended Use Record

The record captures user group, operating context, known limitation, and review
owner as separate source-backed statements.
Change Impact

The workflow links a changed requirement to risk analysis, verification evidence,
and release notes while preserving human review status.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim medical-device compliance, safety effectiveness,
clinical validation, or market authorization. It only exercises portable corpus
artifact generation with license-safe text.
Provenance Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes artifact provenance for a release evidence
bundle without claiming signature validity or external attestation acceptance.
Evidence Chain

The record links source path, content hash, generator version, operator identity,
and timestamp as separate facts.
Verification Step

The workflow compares expected hash, observed hash, artifact path, and reviewer
decision before marking evidence as accepted.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim signed release assurance, legal attestation, or
regulated validation. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with
license-safe text.
Six Sigma CAPA Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes an improvement workflow using neutral process
terms without claiming quality-system compliance or certified methodology use.
Problem Statement

The record captures observed defect, affected process, containment action, and
owner review before root-cause analysis starts.
Effectiveness Check

The workflow links corrective action to metric trend, sample window, reviewer
decision, and residual risk note.
Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim CAPA effectiveness, quality-system compliance, or
Six Sigma certification. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation
with license-safe text.
